# A torn-out vessel's native control route has no witness, and a correct null on main reads as a defect

## Context

A torn-out vessel's native control route — the record that lets the engine move, resize, focus and close a real OS window — has **no test anywhere in the tree**. Its absence is not theoretical: it blocked #18532 for three days, across three probes, twice because the person reading it (me) could not tell a correct `null` from a defect.

**Measured 2026-09-17**, headed, `viewport: null`, real display, one real pop-out of `commits` through the header action, three runs:

| read | value |
|---|---|
| `nativeRouteTtl` | 5000 ms |
| click → adopted | 199 / 297 / 199 ms |
| popup `hasOpener` / `openerMain` | `true` / `true` |
| session token after boot | consumed |
| **main window `nativeRoute`** | **`null`** |
| **popped-out vessel `nativeRoute`** | **full record, all four capabilities `true`** |
| `manager.Window` entry for the vessel | identical record |

The asymmetry is the point and it is **correct behaviour**: main has no opener, so it can mint no route for itself; a vessel's route is minted by its opener at `Main.mjs:1288-1311` and consumed once by the popup at `Main.mjs:22-62`. Nothing says so in a test, so `nativeRoute: false` on a main-window read looks exactly like a broken pop-out.

Live latest-open sweep at 2026-09-17T13:30Z over the latest 20 open issues, plus a targeted search on nativeRoute / vessel / popup capabilities across all states: only #18532, which this serves. A2A: no claim. Own-assignment sweep: no overlap.

## The Problem

`resolveAdmissions` reads the **target's** `nativeRoute` to grant `targetHasHandle`, and `NativeVesselTransaction.parkVessel` refuses the whole park on `!admissions.targetFocus.granted`. So this record is the precondition for every native vessel operation — park, re-show, transfer, close — and it is unobserved.

Three failure modes it leaves open, all silent:

1. **A regression in minting or consuming produces no error.** `consumeNativeWindowRoute` returns `null` on five separate conditions; `resolveNativeWindowRoute` has an early return and a bare `catch`. The popup then caches `null` at module scope (`Main.mjs:10`, `:23`) with no retry, for that window's lifetime.
2. **A capability silently narrowing.** `capabilities` is computed per-window from `typeof win.moveTo === 'function'` and friends. If one turns false, parks stop working and nothing names why.
3. **The main/popup asymmetry gets read as a defect**, which is exactly what happened on #18532 — and cost three probes before a deliberate side-by-side read settled it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/Main.mjs:10` — `let nativeWindowRoute;` at module scope, the once-per-window cache.
- `src/Main.mjs:22-62` — `resolveNativeWindowRoute`, reading the opener-planted token from the popup's own `sessionStorage` and consuming it through the opener.
- `src/Main.mjs:337` — resolved inside `getWindowData()`, on connect.
- `src/Main.mjs:748-778` — `consumeNativeWindowRoute`, which computes `capabilities` and registers the handle.
- `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:974` — the pop-out calling `Neo.Main.windowOpen`, the minting entry point.
- `src/dashboard/dock/window/NativeVesselTransaction.mjs:69-70` — where the route is read back for admissions.
- `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL.spec.mjs:180` — the `popOut` helper this arm **copies** (corrected: it is a trimmed duplicate, not a reuse — neither spec is CI-enrolled, so the two will drift unseen; `e2e/utils` is the home, tracked separately). Its rig facts 1–3 are why the spec needs `viewport: null`.

## The Fix

One e2e arm beside the existing workstation specs: pop out a vessel through the real header action and assert the route the engine will rely on.

- the vessel's `manager.Window` entry carries a `nativeRoute` with `close`, `focus`, `position` and `resize` all `true`
- the **main** window's entry carries `nativeRoute: null` — the same read, opposite expectation, which is what makes the first assertion mean something rather than "some window somewhere has a route"

No product change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — a popped-out vessel's `manager.Window` entry has a `nativeRoute` whose four capabilities are all `true`, read from the app worker, which is the surface `resolveAdmissions` consults.
- [ ] **AC-2** — the main window's entry has `nativeRoute: null` in the same run. This is the control: it is what a correct absence looks like, and the pair is what distinguishes it from a broken pop-out.
- [ ] **AC-3** — the arm drives the real header pop-out action, never `Main.windowOpen` directly. Calling the minting entry point directly would assert that minting works while skipping the path that has to reach it.
- [ ] **AC-4** — headed and `viewport: null`, stated in the spec with the reason: an emulated viewport reports chrome `0` and places real windows off a screen the page believes is smaller.
- [ ] **AC-5** — the arm names, in its own docblock, that a `null` on main is correct, so the next reader of a `nativeRoute: false` does not repeat #18532's three probes.

## Out of Scope

- **#18532's outer-footprint witness.** This is its precondition, not a partial delivery of it — AC-1/AC-2 there are about park/re-show geometry and are untouched.
- Any change to minting, consuming, or the TTL. Measured at 199–297 ms against a 5000 ms budget, so the TTL is not in play; if that ever inverts it is a product ticket, not this one.
- CI enrolment. This needs a real display and `viewport: null`; the e2e tier emulates the viewport, so the arm would be vacuous there. It is a headed maintainer instrument and the spec says so.

## Avoided Traps

- ⛔ **Do not assert only that a route exists.** Main's `null` is the control; without it the arm passes on any run where any window happens to have one.
- ⛔ **Do not read `nativeRoute` as a boolean.** It is a record or `null`, and coercing it is precisely the misreading that produced #18532's phantom blocker — *"all three windows reported `nativeRoute: false`"* was a main-window `null` generalised over popups.
- ⛔ **Do not mint the route directly from the test.** AC-3: that asserts the mechanism while skipping the pop-out that must reach it.

## Related

- #18532 — the witness this unblocks; its four measured preconditions are the map
- #18515 — the `frame = rect − chrome` repair whose e2e witness #18532 exists to build
- #17844 — the Brain-gated e2e selection, which excludes 88 of 116 spec files when `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` is unset; this arm is in that set
